title: Gary McKinnon finds a list of off-planet officers
place_text: US military databases (hacked from the UK)

tellings.quote: a page comes up and it's this list of 11 or 12 off Planet officers

he then stumbles upon a
list of non-terrestrial officers of
which there are 40
tellings.difference: Puts the number of officers at 40 rather than 11 or 12, and adds a space supply-chain theory.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Gary McKinnon's 2001 hack turning up a list of non-terrestrial/off-planet officers.

as_told.title: McKinnon's list of non-terrestrial officers; space supply-chain theory

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells the story of Gary McKinnon, a man in Britain who broke into US military computer systems around 2001 and 2002. According to Michels, McKinnon came across a page listing officers described as off-planet or non-terrestrial, which would point to a hidden space program. In one telling Michels puts the list at 11 or 12 names, and in a later one at 40.
